description: Fishing covers safe, ethical angling: hazards and first aid, rods and reels, essential fishing knots, lures and natural baits, regulations, Leave No Trace and catch and release, and catching, identifying and cooking a fish.

safety.note: Wear a life jacket when fishing from a boat, know how to remove a hook safely, and follow local fishing regulations.

outlineNote: Excerpts showed the topics (health and safety, equipment, knots, lures and baits, regulations, conservation and ethics, and catching and cooking a fish) but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
